text:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout v2.14.0 -> prod (model-service). canary 10% over 5m. changelist: fix kv-cache eviction bug. sha: a1b2c3d

maya: heads-up — can we confirm backout runbook and pinned version in case canary fails? :rotating_light:

liam: Linking runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/ops/backout/model-serve-backout (RB-304). key steps: abort traffic, pin to previous docker tag, scale down new pods, clear kv cache.

sre-oncall: Copying important snippet here for quick access:
```
# escape hatch (manual)
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/model-service model-service=registry.redwood.ai/model-service:2.13.7
kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-service
# if rollout hang, fallback to node drain + scale up stable RC
```

alex: Note: previous stable tag is 2.13.7. We should also pin redis cache proto to v1 to avoid eviction mismatch.

emma: Agree. Also watch these metrics during canary: latency_p50/95, token_error_rate, kv_cache_hit_ratio. If latency_p95 > 800ms for 2 consecutive windows or token_error_rate > 0.8% escalate and backout.

maya: Can we add an automated guard to stop promotion if token_error_rate > 0.5%? Right now deploy-bot promotes at 10m regardless.\
liam: We can set a temporary guard in the deploy pipeline: don't promote if cust-metrics/token_error_rate > 0.5% during canary. I will push a quick check.

deploy-bot: Canary at 10% complete. health: OK. metrics: latency_p95=420ms, token_error_rate=0.12%.

emma: Good. Starting to nudge to 30% in 10m if metrics stable. Confirming runbook contact list: @liam @sre-oncall @maya on rotation.

maya: Also adding a pre-approved rollback commit message for audit: "backout: rollback to 2.13.7 due to kv-cache mismatch - RB-304". Keep that in the deploy ticket.

alex: If we have to backout, remember to also rollback model pin in feature flags: ff:model-serving-version -> 2.13.7.

liam: Pushed the pipeline guard. Will monitor. If anything flaps I'll execute runbook steps above and ping #incidents.

deploy-bot: Canary at 30%. health: OK. metrics: latency_p95=460ms, token_error_rate=0.18% :white_check_mark:

maya: Great. Hold for full rollout window (15m). If stable after that, promote to 100%.

sre-oncall: Ack. Oncall standing by for backout. Logged runbook RB-304 into the release ticket.

deploy-bot: Promotion to 100% scheduled in 10m.

emma: Before promotion, quick sanity: confirm monitoring export is active and alert set to notify both #incidents and pagers.

liam: Confirmed. Pager policy: severity >= P2 will page oncall.

maya: Thanks team — will call it if any signal at all. :pray:

deploy-bot: Promotion started. 100% traffic rolled. Final health check: latency_p95=480ms, token_error_rate=0.22%.

emma: Marking as released in changelog and noting backout plan used: RB-304, pinned version 2.13.7 if needed. Closing thread after 30m stable window.

sre-oncall: Logging post-release note: ran dry-run of backout commands earlier. Ready to execute if required.

maya: closing — thanks. :tada:
